atoms.text: Marcello’s juice bar is selling different kinds of juices. The berry juice contains 45% water, 5% brown sugar and 50% blended fruits. The orange juice contains 2/3 blended fruits and 1/3 water. The tropical juice is made of 3/5 blended fruits, 30% coconut cream and 1/10 brown sugar.

atoms.a: Which juice contains the largest amount of fruit?
Which juice contains the largest amount of brown sugar?
Which juice contains the largest amount of water?

atoms.text: Stella wants to get rid of some of her clothes. She goes through everything and makes three piles. The first pile, which is clothes she wants to keep, makes up <mat>1/2</mat> of her clothes. The second pile, which is clothes she wants to donate to charity, makes up 30% of the clothes. The third pile is of clothes that she wants to give to friends, and it makes up <mat>1/5</mat> of her clothes.

atoms.a: What percentage of Stella’s clothes are in the first pile?
What percentage of Stella’s clothes are in the third pile?

atoms.text: Around 13% of the population in the USA is left-handed, whereas in Germany, only 10% are left-handed and in India only 5%. France’s population is 11% left-handed.

atoms.a: Which country has the largest percentage of left-handed people?
Which country has the smallest percentage of left-handed people?
Which country has the largest percentage of right-handed people?
